statement: h05's predecessor session was killed by a session-limit but left a high-quality salvageable artifact in its dead worktree: a complete 490-line economic_invariants.rs with both Validators (ECON-INVARIANT-PRESENCE.1, ECON-INVARIANT-SHAPE.1) and 8 passing unit tests, plus 5 of 9 needed fixture files. The unit tests already referenced 4 fixtures that did not yet exist on disk (attacker_cost/good/cost_property.json, compensation/bad/compensation_missing.json, compensation/good/compensation_property.json, plain_util/good/plain_util.json) — the module compiled but its own test module would not have without creating them. Registry wiring (mod.rs pub mod line, registry.rs rows, rules/economic-invariants.json rule records, doc anchors in the workpack file) was entirely unstarted.
why: When resuming a salvaged worktree, do not assume 'file exists and has tests' means 'workpack complete' — always diff the fixtures a module's own #[cfg(test)] block references against what actually exists on disk, and always check the mod.rs/registry.rs seam separately from the rule module itself.
howToApply: On salvage: (1) read the rule module's test module fully to enumerate every fixture path referenced, (2) `find` the fixtures dir and diff against that enumeration, (3) check mod.rs for the `pub mod <name>;` line and registry.rs for the RegistryRow entries before assuming registration happened, (4) check the rules/*.json rule-record file for the rule ids and their docAnchor targets — doc anchors need the literal rule id text somewhere in the anchor target file, not just a markdown heading.

evidence.ref: cargo test -p enforcer-security economic_invariants: 8 passed only after creating the 4 missing fixtures; registry_builds_cleanly required manual mod.rs+registry.rs edits

statement: clippy::doc_lazy_continuation fires on rustdoc `//!`/`///` comments where a paragraph is written as a run-on sentence split across lines with a leading `*` used as prose (not markdown list syntax) — e.g. 'foo * bar * baz' wrapped across lines gets parsed as an indented list continuation. Fixed in economic_invariants.rs's module doc by replacing the inline `*`-separated invariant list with comma-separated prose.
why: The workspace's clippy DENY wall (-D warnings) treats this as an error, not a warning; any doc comment using `*` as an inline separator/bullet across a line wrap will fail cargo clippy CI even though it renders fine and reads fine as an author.
howToApply: When a doc comment lists items separated by `*` and wraps across multiple `//!` lines, either use comma-separated prose (no `*`) or convert to an explicit markdown list where every continuation line is indented to match the list marker.

evidence.ref: cargo clippy -p enforcer-security --all-targets -- -D warnings: error: doc list item without indentation at economic_invariants.rs:17 before fix

statement: The ocentra-enforcer coordination MCP tools (claim/message/etc.) reported themselves stale at session start (expected per protocol v2) and the recommended ocentra_enforcer_run fallback to scripts/rust-rules.mjs also failed with ENOENT on .ledger/ocentra-parent/identity/node.json — the coordination hub's node identity file does not exist in this environment/worktree. This is an infra gap outside h05's owns: scope (crates/enforcer-security/src/rules/economic_invariants.rs + tests/fixtures/economic_invariants/**), not something to fix inline.
why: Future lanes hitting the same stale-MCP + fallback-ENOENT combination should not spend time debugging their own workpack for a coordination-hub identity bootstrap problem — it is a pre-existing infra gap.
howToApply: If ocentra_enforcer_run fallback for coordination claim/message fails with ENOENT on .ledger/<project>/identity/node.json, treat it as a known coordination-hub bootstrap gap (likely needs `enforcer coordination init` or equivalent run once for the project), proceed with the actual workpack code+proof work, and report the blocker rather than attempting local workarounds inside the owns: scope.

evidence.ref: ocentra_enforcer_run coordination claim/message: exit code 2, 'ENOENT: no such file or directory, open .ledger\ocentra-parent\identity\node.json'
